name: Raumdeuter Counter 4-2-3-1

slots.why: Distributes quickly to the wingers or attacking midfielder to start the counter.
Defensive full-back stays back and lets the winger and raumdeuter do the attacking, which keeps the block compact.
Central defender. Cover is the alternate.
Cover centre-back sweeps up behind his partner; Defend is the alternate.
Defensive full-back on the right stays back for the same reason.
Holding midfielder screens the defence and does the simple defensive work.
Supporting midfielder wins the ball and starts the counter with a simple pass.
Raumdeuter drifts inside from his flank into the gaps between defenders and arrives at the far post; he does little defensive work.
Attacking midfielder plays between the lines and runs beyond the striker on the counter.
Winger (Support) provides the width the raumdeuter does not, so the counter is not all down one side.
Complete forward runs in behind or holds the ball up, according to what the counter needs.

description: A cautious 4-2-3-1 that defends in a compact shape and counters through a raumdeuter who finds space on the flank, an attacking midfielder and a quick striker.
whyGood: The raumdeuter's movement is hard to mark, so the counter arrives at the far post from a player the defence has lost track of.
whyThisShape: Defensive full-backs and a double pivot keep the team compact, and the front four are set up to hit quickly. The raumdeuter does not build play: he waits for the ball to be won and then runs into whichever space opens. The other flank has a winger who supplies width so the counter does not all come down one side.
whenToUse: Against a stronger team that will leave space behind its full-backs, when you have a smart off-the-ball player who scores goals.
whenNotToUse: When you have to dominate the ball, since only two players create; or when the raumdeuter cannot finish.

instructionRationale.Slightly More Direct Passing: Gets the ball forward to the runners quickly after winning it.
instructionRationale.Pass Into Space: Plays the ball behind the defence for the raumdeuter and striker to run onto.
instructionRationale.Counter: Attacks straight away on winning the ball, which is the purpose of the system.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Falls back into shape after losing the ball, before the next counter.
instructionRationale.Lower Line of Engagement: Lets the opponent have the ball in their own half, which creates the space to counter into.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the block compact.

keyRequirements: A raumdeuter with good movement and finishing
